subject: YC hackathon — quick question about your agent costs
baseBody:
Hi, I’m Marc, building at today’s YC hackathon. We’re testing whether discovering and reusing repeated agent workflows can reduce inference costs while preserving successful outcomes.

Have you spent engineering time reducing the cost of recurring tasks in your product? What have you tried?

A quick reply or five-minute call today would really help us understand whether we’re solving a meaningful problem.

knownBounces.reason: Recipient group permits organization and allowed senders only; 550 5.7.133

incoming.summary: Says request was shared with the support team. No answer on inference costs, no pilot or LOI.
Confirms receipt and says team will get back to Marc. No answer to cost questions or commitment.
